question: Why did the later FAST_SHOCK_SYSTEMIC Path-A formulation fail held-out 2020 when the broader causal multi-market classifier detected 2020 on 2020-03-12 and the earlier DEV50 emergency architecture fired on 2020-03-06; can a scientifically defensible market-wide fast-shock rule reduce detection damage without forcing an earlier date?
architecture_invariant: A, B and C operate simultaneously; A OR B OR C authorizes DEFENSIVE. This experiment changes only A.

old_DEV50_emergency.provenance: diagnostic clue only; not admissible as a market-wide validated A rule

failure_hypotheses: five-session confirmation is structurally too slow/strict for a fast shock
requiring shock5 and funding simultaneously at the same high percentile loses useful cross-market concurrence
drawdown state and/or VVIX contains orthogonal information omitted from failed FAST-A
breadth collapse contains orthogonal information omitted from failed FAST-A
LOCO training on 2008 and 2022 selected morphology that does not transport to exogenous COVID shock
old DEV50 signal was stock-lab-specific and may not transport to a true market-wide rule
admitted_feature_families: market drawdown magnitude/speed and 1/5-day shock already admitted by parent protocols
realized volatility/extreme move clustering already admitted by parent protocols
VIX/VVIX level/change/causal rolling percentile already admitted by parent protocols
full-market breadth level/change/collapse velocity already admitted by parent protocols
OFR Funding/Credit level/change/acceleration with two-business-day publication lag
sparse cross-market concurrence among these families
analysis_sequence: reconstruct causal daily feature tape from surviving/raw admitted sources; label reconstruction explicitly
reproduce or explain the March-12 benchmark state feature-by-feature
reproduce or explain why failed FAST-A shock5+funding with five-session confirmation never fires
perform confirmation ablation 1/2/3/5 without portfolio fitness
perform sparse feature ablations/additions only within preregistered admitted families
evaluate all-history false-alert episodes and alert days, including 2015 and ordinary stress
select no rule unless detection improvement survives false-alert and transport scrutiny
freeze detector before any MTS portfolio DD/CAGR diagnostic
selection_priority: material subsequent downside remaining at declaration
earlier declaration only after the above

portfolio_diagnostic_after_freeze.win_condition: Reducing drawdown while holding or increasing CAGR is a win; earlier detection is not a win if false exits or lost upside reduce overall usefulness.
portfolio_diagnostic_after_freeze.prohibition: Portfolio DD/CAGR/wealth may judge the frozen detector but may not choose its features, thresholds, confirmation, or rule.

stop_rules: Do not force a rule earlier than 2020-03-12.
If earlier variants materially increase false alerts or fail transport, retain the later defensible detection.
If no market-wide A rule transports, report Path-A limitation/failure rather than tuning to 2020.
If the analysis reveals a genuinely distinct mechanism outside A/B/C, preregister it before testing; do not invent a path post hoc.
R1_progression: BLOCKED until Path-A 2020 discrepancy is resolved or explicitly accepted as a documented limitation.
